{{Hatnote|For the Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game card, see [[Vader]].}}
'''Vader''' is a gameplay icon printed on some [[Players Committee]] virtual cards. Game text calls them "[Vader] cards": [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]] reads "[Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table."<ref name="vb71">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Power release sheet], Players Committee (official text as of 18 June 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095326/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
